detail.readme:
# Peach A local-first video metadata scraper and media manager. [Website](https://peach.video) · [Download](#download-and-use) · [Live demo](https://demo.peach.video) · [Documentation](#documentation) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/peach-mitao/peach?include_prereleases&sort=semver&label=release&logo=github)](https://github.com/peach-mitao/peach/releases) [![CI pipelines](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/peach-mitao/peach/test.yml?branch=master&label=CI&logo=githubactions&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/peach-mitao/peach/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-AGPL--3.0--or--later-blue?logo=gnu&logoColor=white)](LICENSE) [![Windows x64](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-x64-0078D4)](docs/TESTING_DESKTOP.md) [![macOS DMG](https://img.shields.io/badge/macOS-DMG-555555?logo=apple&logoColor=white)](docs/OPERATIONS.md#macos-独立测试包) [![Age restrictions](https://img.shields.io/badge/age-18%2B-555555)](#license) ## Screenshots [![Video library with search, filters and posters](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/home-wide-20261025-2-1280.webp)](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/home-wide-20261025-2.png) Movie demo data; see [asset credits and licenses](https://peach.video/en/credits/).
More screenshots **People and works** [![Charlie Chaplin's profile and films](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/profile-wide-20261025-2-1280.webp)](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/profile-wide-20261025-2.png) **Creator updates** [![Creator follows and new works](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/follow-wide-20261025-2-1280.webp)](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/follow-wide-20261025-2.png) **Library statistics** [![Library, storage and viewing statistics](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/stats-wide-20261025-3-1280.webp)](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/stats-wide-20261025-3.png) **Player** [![Big Buck Bunny player](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/play-wide-20261025-2-1280.webp)](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/play-wide-20261025-2.png)
## Features - **Metadata scraping**: recognize video codes, read NFO files and fill titles, performers, studios and covers from multiple sources while keeping your edits. - **Local and cloud libraries**: browse local drives, SMB, mounted cloud storage and PikPak libraries together. - **Playback and history**: web and external players, subtitles, playback speed, rotation, resume and timeline previews. - **Follows and discovery**: track performer and creator updates, discover titles and manage a want list. - **Cloud download**: search by video code or submit a magnet link, then organize completed downloads into your library. - **Library management**: manage tags, duplicates, versions and parts; permanently delete videos by performer while keeping profiles and photos. Metadata and watch history are stored locally. - **Task center**: pause, resume or cancel local background tasks and view their CPU, GPU and download activity where available. ## Download and use | Method | Get started | | --- | --- | | Windows x64 | [Installer](https://github.com/peach-mitao/peach/releases/download/v0.57.0/Peach-0.57.0-windows-x64-setup.exe) · [Portable](https://github.com/peach-mitao/peach/releases/download/v0.57.0/Peach-0.57.0-windows-x64.zip) | | macOS | [Apple Silicon / ARM64](https://github.com/peach-mitao/peach/releases/download/v0.57.0/Peach-0.57.0-macos-arm64.dmg) · [Intel / x86_64](https://github.com/peach-mitao/peach/releases/download/v0.57.0/Peach-0.57.0-macos-x86_64.dmg) | | Docker / NAS | [Deployment guide](docs/DOCKER.md) | | Source | [Setup instructions](docs/OPERATIONS.md#从源码运行windowsmacos); requires Git, uv and Python 3.14+ | Choose your media folders after installation, then scan to start browsing and playing. Desktop test builds are unsigned, and macOS builds are not notarized. See the [Windows](docs/TESTING_DESKTOP.md) and [macOS](docs/OPERATIONS.md#macos-独立测试包) guides. ## Documentation [Operations](docs/OPERATIONS.md) · [Sources](docs/SOURCING.md) · [External players](docs/EXTERNAL_PLAYERS.md) · [Diagnostics and data sharing](docs/DIAGNOSTICS.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) Development: [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Development guide](AGENTS.md) · [Testing](docs/TESTING.md) ## Reporting problems [Report a bug or suggest a feature](https://github.com/peach-mitao/peach/issues/new/choose) with your version, steps and error message. Use demo data in public screenshots and redact private information; do not upload videos or databases. Report vulnerabilities privately through the [security policy](SECURITY.md). ## Related projects Thanks to [amane](https://github.com/sqzw-x/amane), [Gfriends](https://github.com/gfriends/gfriends) and [CloudDrive2](https://www.clouddrive2.com/). See the [reuse inventory](docs/REUSE.md) for full credits. ## Star History ## License [AGPL-3.0-or-later](LICENSE) · Copyright (C) 2026 The Peach contributors. Third-party components retain their own licenses. Use of the Peach name and logo follows the [name and logo policy](docs/TRADEMARKS.md). Manage only media you own or are authorized to use, subject to laws, copyright and source-platform access, age and regional restrictions. Peach does not provide video resources or access to paid content.

# Peach 本地优先的影片刮削与媒体管理工具。 [官网](https://peach.video) · [下载](#下载与使用) · [在线演示](https://demo.peach.video) · [文档](#文档) · [English](README.md) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/peach-mitao/peach?include_prereleases&sort=semver&label=release&logo=github)](https://github.com/peach-mitao/peach/releases) [![CI 流水线](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/peach-mitao/peach/test.yml?branch=master&label=CI&logo=githubactions&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/peach-mitao/peach/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![许可证](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-AGPL--3.0--or--later-blue?logo=gnu&logoColor=white)](LICENSE) [![Windows x64](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-x64-0078D4)](docs/TESTING_DESKTOP.md) [![macOS DMG](https://img.shields.io/badge/macOS-DMG-555555?logo=apple&logoColor=white)](docs/OPERATIONS.md#macos-独立测试包) [![年龄限制](https://img.shields.io/badge/age-18%2B-555555)](#许可证) ## 截图 [![影片馆藏：搜索、筛选与海报墙](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/home-wide-20261025-2-1280.webp)](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/home-wide-20261025-2.png) 电影演示资料，来源与许可见[素材说明](https://peach.video/credits/)。
更多截图 **人物与作品** [![查理·卓别林的资料与作品](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/profile-wide-20261025-2-1280.webp)](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/profile-wide-20261025-2.png) **创作者关注** [![创作者关注与作品更新](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/follow-wide-20261025-2-1280.webp)](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/follow-wide-20261025-2.png) **馆藏统计** [![馆藏、存储与观看统计](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/stats-wide-20261025-3-1280.webp)](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/stats-wide-20261025-3.png) **播放器** [![Big Buck Bunny 播放器](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/play-wide-20261025-2-1280.webp)](https://peach.video/assets/screenshots/play-wide-20261025-2.png)
## 能做什么 - **影片刮削**：识别影片编号，读取 NFO，多来源补齐标题、演员、厂牌和封面，保留人工修改。 - **本地与网盘**：统一浏览本地硬盘、SMB、已挂载网盘和 PikPak 媒体库。 - **播放与记录**：网页与外部播放器、字幕、倍速、旋转、续播和时间轴预览。 - **关注与发现**：订阅人物与创作者更新，发现作品，管理「想要」清单。 - **云下载**：按影片编号查找或提交磁力，下载完成后整理入库。 - **馆藏管理**：管理标签、重复文件、多版本与分卷；按女优批量永久删除影片，保留人物档案和照片。资料和观看记录保存在本机。 - **任务中心**：暂停、继续或取消本机后台任务，查看可取得的各任务 CPU、GPU 与下载活动。 ## 下载与使用 | 方式 | 入口 | | --- | --- | | Windows x64 | [安装版](https://github.com/peach-mitao/peach/releases/download/v0.57.0/Peach-0.57.0-windows-x64-setup.exe) · [免安装版](https://github.com/peach-mitao/peach/releases/download/v0.57.0/Peach-0.57.0-windows-x64.zip) | | macOS | [Apple Silicon / ARM64](https://github.com/peach-mitao/peach/releases/download/v0.57.0/Peach-0.57.0-macos-arm64.dmg) · [Intel / x86_64](https://github.com/peach-mitao/peach/releases/download/v0.57.0/Peach-0.57.0-macos-x86_64.dmg) | | Docker / NAS | [部署说明](docs/DOCKER.md) | | 源码运行 | [安装步骤](docs/OPERATIONS.md#从源码运行windowsmacos)，需要 Git、uv 和 Python 3.14+ | 安装后选择媒体目录，扫描后即可浏览与播放。桌面测试包未签名，macOS 尚未完成公证；详见 [Windows](docs/TESTING_DESKTOP.md) 与 [macOS](docs/OPERATIONS.md#macos-独立测试包) 说明。 ## 文档 [运行与配置](docs/OPERATIONS.md) · [来源支持](docs/SOURCING.md) · [外部播放器](docs/EXTERNAL_PLAYERS.md) · [诊断与数据分享](docs/DIAGNOSTICS.md) · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md) 参与开发：[贡献说明](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [开发约定](AGENTS.md) · [测试](docs/TESTING.md) ## 问题反馈 [提交问题或建议](https://github.com/peach-mitao/peach/issues/new/choose)，附版本、复现步骤与报错。公开截图使用演示资料，遮盖隐私；不要上传影片或数据库。安全问题按[安全政策](SECURITY.md)私下报告。 ## 相关项目 感谢 [amane](https://github.com/sqzw-x/amane)、[Gfriends](https://github.com/gfriends/gfriends) 与 [CloudDrive2](https://www.clouddrive2.com/)；完整致谢见[复用清单](docs/REUSE.md)。 ## Star 历史 ## 许可证 [AGPL-3.0-or-later](LICENSE) · Copyright (C) 2026 The Peach contributors。第三方组件保留各自的许可证。Peach 名称与图标的使用见[名称与标识政策](docs/TRADEMARKS.md)。 仅管理自行持有或获授权使用的媒体，遵守法律、版权及来源平台的访问、年龄和地区限制。Peach 不提供影片资源或付费内容访问权。
